title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect
overview: The AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate course is designed to prepare IT professionals for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam. This course covers essential AWS services, solutions architecture best practices, and the skills needed to design and deploy scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant systems on AWS.
audience: IT professionals with experience in designing distributed systems and solutions.
Solution architects, developers, and system administrators seeking AWS certification.
Cloud engineers and consultants interested in validating their skills in AWS architecture.
Individuals aiming to enhance their understanding of AWS services and solutions.
methodology: Interactive Lectures: In-depth explanations of AWS services and architectural principles.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises to deploy and manage AWS solutions.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to understand application design and best practices.
Group Discussions: Collaborative sessions to solve architectural challenges.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate knowledge and readiness for certification.
competencies: Deployment and management of AWS services
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of AWS services and solutions architecture.
To prepare participants for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam.
To enable participants to design, deploy, and manage scalable and resilient systems on AWS.
To familiarize learners with best practices for security, cost management, and high availability in AWS.

items.text: Designing Highly Available and Fault-Tolerant Systems
Load Balancing with ELB (Elastic Load Balancing)
Working with Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service)
Using AWS CloudFormation for Infrastructure as Code
Network Security with Security Groups and NACLs

Choosing the Right Storage Options (S3, EBS, EFS)
Managing Databases with Amazon RDS and DynamoDB
Data Backup and Disaster Recovery Strategies
Implementing Caching Solutions with Amazon ElastiCache
Using AWS Trusted Advisor for Best Practices
